title: Technology Sector Update for 10/16/2018: LPSN,ADBE,PLUG,MRVL
text:

Technology stocks were helping lead U.S. markets higher, with shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 Tuesday adding more than 2.4% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was rising almost 2.6%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) LivePerson ( LPSN ) was posting a nearly 4% gain on Tuesday, after announcing its purchase of AdvantageTec. It plans to combine the texting application with its Contact At Once! automotive unit, creating a platform for conversational sales activity across an entire car dealership. Financial details of the transaction were not disclosed.
In other sector news:
(+) Adobe Systems ( ADBE ) climbed more than 8% after saying it was on track to achieve Q4 fiscal year 2018 revenue of $2.42 billion and EPS of $1.42 on a GAAP-basis, and $1.87 on a non-GAAP basis, as well as meet other financial metrics it targeted for the quarter, excluding the impact of its pending acquisition of Marketo. .
(+) Plug Power ( PLUG ) Tuesday climbed 3.7% after the fuel cell technology company raised its FY18 revenue outlook to a new range of $175 million to $190 million, up from its prior forecast of $155 million to $180 million.
(+) Marvell Technology Group ( MRVL ) climbed 5% in recent Tuesday trading after authorizing an extra $700 million for its existing stock buyback program, increasing its overall repurchase capacity to $1 billion.
